description: Read-only GraphShard check through viewer/json capabilities and tabletinfo for the configured tenant. Returns graphShardExists, tablet ids, and viewer status details; use after tenant bootstrap when GraphShard support or tablet visibility is the specific question.

configPath.description: Absolute path to an explicit local-ydb config file. Missing, unreadable, oversized, or invalid explicit files fail closed instead of using defaults.

profile.description: Named profile from local-ydb.config.json. Defaults to config.defaultProfile.

name: local_ydb_graphshard_check
